pdf_page_count reads the page count of a PDF without rendering a page

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { pdfPageCount } from "@xberg-io/xberg-wasm";
function main() {
  const _pdf_bytes_content = await (await import("node:fs/promises")).readFile("pdf/sample_contract.pdf");
  const result = pdfPageCount(_pdf_bytes_content);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
